label: sdc01_0300_sister_01
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]There you are, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]!
Come on,
get
a
load
of
this
view![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0300_sister_02
text: This is the Crystal Pool. Bet you didn’t expect it\nto be so pretty, huh?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0300_sister_03
text: The crystals here are always shining. Isn’t that\nstrange? There’s even a weird rumor that you\r\ncan meet people here who’ve passed away.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0300_sister_04
text: Now we’ll just need to get a little bit of the\ncrystal from the bottom of the pool so we can\r\nfix the mask properly![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0300_sister_05
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]And that’s where you come in,
[VAR 0x0100(0000)]!
Go on,
then!
Jump in!
Don’t
be
scared![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0300_select_01
text: Wait, you want ME to jump in?!

label: sdc01_0300_select_02
text: Jump in? Like, into the pool?!

label: sdc01_0300_sister_06
text: Well, yeah. I can’t swim. And besides, my clothes\nwould get soaked if I did it.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0300_sister_07
text: You’ve got a real nifty Pokémon to ride on, right?\nYou’ll be fiiiiiine![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0300_system_01
text: *rumble rumble*

label: sdc01_0300_sister_08
text: What in the—?! An earthquake?![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0300_poke_01
text: Mi-lo-lo-lo-lo-lo!

label: sdc01_0300_sister_09
text: Sheesh, that surprised me![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0300_sister_10
text: Now that I think about it, Pokémon like that one\ndo show up here from time to time...[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0300_sister_11
text: Y’know, you’re pretty handy to have around in a\nbattle, aren’t you?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0300_sister_12
text: Hey, is that...?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0300_sister_13
text: Maybe it was stuck to that Pokémon you fought?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0300_bbteacher_01
text: The energy coming from those crystals at the\nbottom of the pool... I knew it![VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc01_0300_sister_14
text: Ms. Briar![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0300_bbteacher_02
text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]Hi there, Carmine. And
[VAR 0x0100(0000)],
too!\c
I thought you were paired with other students.
Did you decide to switch things up?[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc01_0300_sister_15
text: Uh... I’m sorry, Ms. Briar, but this place is\nactually pretty special. I’m not a big fan of\r\noutsiders just wandering around up here.[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0300_bbteacher_03
text: I’m aware that this is sacred ground, yes.[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc01_0300_bbteacher_04
text: I did get permission from the caretaker, though.\nWas that not sufficient?[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc01_0300_sister_16
text: ...Why did you come here?[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0300_bbteacher_05
text: Oh, just doing a bit of field research. I was\ninterested in the properties of the water here.[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc01_0300_bbteacher_06
text: And, well...my hunch was on the money![VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc01_0300_bbteacher_07
text: You see, the Crystal Pool’s waters emit energy\nof the same wavelength as Terastal energy.\r\nThough I have no idea why that is...[VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc01_0300_bbteacher_08
text: Once I figure that out, I might be able to\nstabilize the Terastal phenomenon in regions\r\nother than Paldea![VAR 0x0114(0042)]

label: sdc01_0300_sister_18
text: Well, um... We’ve got somewhere to be, so...[VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0300_sister_19
text: Let’s head back, [VAR 0x0100(0000)]![VAR 0x0114(0044)]

label: sdc01_0300_bbteacher_09
text: If I can just get the Terastal phenomenon to\nreliably occur in regions other than Paldea, that\r\nshould bring me one step closer to Terapagos...[VAR 0x0114(0042)]
